spec_provided_observability.name: Response UPIU status + SCSI sense data
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Every command returns a Response UPIU with SCSI status (GOOD / CHECK CONDITION) and sense data for error diagnosis.

spec_provided_observability.name: Device Health Descriptor
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Pre-EOL information and estimated device life-time (bDeviceLifeTimeEstA/B) for endurance monitoring.

spec_provided_observability.name: Query Attributes/Flags
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Read current power mode, RTT limits, error counters, and feature-enable state without the SCSI path.

spec_provided_observability.name: UFSHCI Interrupt Status (IS) + error registers
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Host controller reports UTP errors, UIC errors, and link-layer error aggregation.

spec_provided_observability.name: UniPro DME error counters
spec_provided_observability.purpose: UniPro Device Management Entity exposes PHY-adapter and data-link error counters via UIC GET commands.

error_detection_mechanisms: Header ECC (Hamming 8,4) single-bit-correct / double-bit-detect on every packet header.
Payload CRC-16 (poly 0x1021, init 0xFFFF, MSB-first) on every Long-Packet payload.
Sync-pattern miss-lock — receiver fails to find 8'b00011101 within HS-Zero window; entire burst lost.
T-HS-* timing violation — per-lane bit errors; usually surface as ECC / CRC failures.
Lane-skew exceeded — multi-lane payload de-interleave misalignment; ECC / CRC failures.
LP-Contention — both endpoints assert mutually exclusive LP states.
False EoT (End-of-Transmission) — HS-Trail violated or missing LP-11 return.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: Short Packet DT=0x00 received with valid ECC.
Short Packet DT=0x01 received with valid ECC.
1-bit error in header ECC was corrected.
2-bit error in header ECC was detected; packet dropped.
Receiver did not find Sync within HS-Zero window.
Source / sink escape commands; bus enters / exits Ultra-Low Power State.

notes: UFS does not define a JTAG/scan port on the device package edge. Host-side debug relies on (a) Response UPIU status + SCSI sense, (b) Reject UPIUs, (c) Query-readable Health/Attributes, (d) UFSHCI interrupt/error registers, and (e) M-PHY/UniPro protocol-analyzer captures of the differential lanes.
scope_observability: High-speed differential probing of the M-PHY lane pairs requires a high-bandwidth oscilloscope and a UFS/M-PHY protocol analyzer; eye-diagram and gear/power-mode transitions are observable at the lane.
Protocol analyzers decode UniPro frames and UPIU transactions to trace command/response/data flow.
RESET_n and REF_CLK are low-speed and directly probeable.
ate_or_dft: Internal NAND test, ECC scrub, scan and BIST are vendor-specific and accessed at wafer/package probe, not exposed over the UFS link. The link-level observability is via UPIU status, Query Descriptors/Attributes/Flags, UFSHCI error registers, and UniPro DME counters.
